frequency_question: How often do monthly headline inflation prints exceed 5.0% in consecutive two-year horizons under similar baseline monetary regimes?
membership_rule: Members are monthly headline CPI year-on-year inflation figures published by national statistical agencies for major emerging market economies over the past decade, excluding periods of acute hyperinflation or sudden wartime commodity shocks.
provenance_note: claimed 8 hits but 7 of 12 cases are marked hit; rate recomputed from the cases
coverage_note: 12 named monthly prints sampled across recent baseline periods.
known_gaps: Excludes extreme outlier months driven by unpredicted weather anomalies.
validity_reason: Macroeconomic regime structures and central bank inflation targeting bands remain stable over this horizon.
